coverage_override.reason: Hand activation permission, monster-effect negation/destruction, and destruction-triggered draw are three individual effects with their corresponding HOPT limits.

effects.printed_clause: During your turn, if your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, you can activate this card from your hand. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_HAND checks that it is the controller's turn and the opponent controls at least two monsters; the Trap activation has its HOPT code.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Trap hand-activation permission uses EFFECT_TRAP_ACT_IN_HAND with a field-state condition.

effects.printed_clause: When your opponent activates a monster effect while you control a "Chrono-Saur" monster: Negate that effect, and if you do, you can destroy that card or 1 card in your hand or field. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The HOPT activation checks an opponent monster effect and a face-up controlled archetype monster, negates the effect, then optionally selects its handler or any destructible card in the controller's hand/on-field group, now including this resolving Trap itself.

official_references.matched_structure: Official monster-effect response checks chain disablability and resolves with Duel.NegateEffect.
Official 'destroy 1 card in your hand or field' operation selects from the full LOCATION_HAND+LOCATION_ONFIELD group without excluding a handler.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the resolving Trap is still a card in your field and the unqualified printed choice includes it; the prior exception e:GetHandler() unlawfully removed that choice.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is destroyed by card effect: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed HOPT EVENT_DESTROYED trigger requires REASON_EFFECT and draws one card if permitted.

official_references.matched_structure: Official delayed EVENT_DESTROYED trigger checks destruction circumstances.
Official draw effect checks draw permission and resolves with Duel.Draw.
